spans.s:
(उ) तृणु r. 8th cl. (तर्णोति तर्णुते or तृणोति तृणुते)
To eat, especially grass, to graze.

n. (-णं)
Grass, any gramineous plant.
E.
तृह to hurt, Uṇādi affix क्न, and ह rejected; what is consumed by cattle, &c.

n. (-मं)
A sort of perfume.
E.
तृण grass, कुङ्कुम saffron.

f. (-टी)
A hovel, a hut of grass or straw.
E.
तृण grass, and कुटी a small house.

m. (-र्म्मः)
A long gourd, (Cueurbita lagenaria.)
E.
तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.

m. (-तुः)
A bambu.
E.
तृण grass, and केतु a banner.

f. (-धा)
1 A kind of newt.
2 A chameleon.
3 A worm.
E.
तृण grass, and गोधा a lizard.

m. (-ही)
1 Amber, &c. or any gem which being rubbed becomes electrically attractive.
2 Sapphire.
E.
तृण grass, and ग्राहिन् what seizes.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
1 Graminivorous, one whose food is grass.
2 Grass-toothed, having teeth of the colour of grass, &c.
E.
तृण grass, and जम्भ food, or a tooth.

m. (-तिः)
The vegetable kingdom.
E.
तृण, and जाति genus.

f. (-ता)
1 A bow.
2 The aggregate properties of grass or herbage, gramineousness.
E.
तल् affix of the abstract, added to तृण; also तृणत्व, n. (-त्वं.)

m. (-मः)
A palm tree, any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoanut, date, &c.
E.
तृण grass, and द्रुम a tree; pre-eminent amongst gramineous plants.

m. (-न्यः)
Grain growing wild or without cultivation.
E.
तृण grass, and धान्य grain, corn.

m. (-जः)
A bambu.
E.
तृण grass, and ध्वज a flag or banner.

f. (-ली)
A mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work.
E.
तृण grass, पूल to gather together, affixes अण् and ङीष्.

m. (-णिः)
A sort of gem, apparently^1 amber.
E.
तृण grass, and मणि a gem; attracting straws, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-णः)
A bail or surety.

m. (-जः)
A palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.)
E.
तृण grass, and राजन् a sovereign, टच् affix, leaving a final vowel.

m. (-रः)
A heap of grass.
E.
तृण, and विस्तर expanse.

n. (-तं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
E.
तृण grass, and शीत here said to imply abundance.

mfn. subst. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Arabian jasmine.
adj.
Free from or devoid of grass.
n. (-न्यं)
The flower of the Ketaki.
E.
तृण grass, शून्य void of.

m. (-दः)
A wasp.
E.
तृण grass, and षट्पद् six-foot; an insect haunting meadows, &c. having six feet.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Grassy, made, &c. with grass.
E.
तृण grass, and स aff.

f. (-रा)
The plantain or banana.
E.
तृण grass, and सार essence, pith.

m. (-हः)
An axe.
E.
तृण grass, and सिंह a lion.

m. (-र्म्म्र्यः)
A hovel, a house or upper-room of grass or straw.
E.
तृण grass, and हर्म्म्र्य a mansion.

m. (-ग्निः)
1 Conflagration of chaff.
2 Burning a criminal wrapped up in straw.
E.
तृण grass, and अग्नि fire: see तुषानल.

m. (-नः)
A chameleon, a lizard.
E.
तृण grass, and अञ्जन a lizard.

m. (-क्षुः)
A kind of long grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
E.
तृण, and इक्षु sugar cane.

m. (-वः)
Rice, &c. growing wild or without cultivation.
E.
तृण grass, and उद्भव produced.

f. (-ल्का)
A firebrand made of a wisp of straw.
E.
तृण grass, and उल्का a firebrand.

n. (-कः)
A hovel, a hut, a house of straw or mats.
E.
तृण grass, and ओकस् abode.

n. (-धं)
A perfume, commonly Elavāluka.
E.
तृण, and औषध a drug; resembling grass in its appearance.

f. (-ण्या)
A heap or quantity of grass.
E.
तृण grass, यत् and टाप् affs.
